acceptance_checks.current_desktop_platform: Electron 42 three-process desktop app in packages/desktop (main/preload/renderer, sandboxed renderer via contextBridge); editor engine @muyajs/core (packages/muya TS rewrite) with legacy @marktext/muyajs (packages/muyajs) still aliased and being retired.
runtime_boundaries_identified: main/preload/renderer process boundary (main owns OS/files/watcher/BrowserWindow/native menus; renderer owns UI/tabs/DOM editor; renderer must not use Electron/Node directly, only typed sender-scoped capability)
Window identity and routing (main authoritative for window lifecycle and open-path routing; BrowserWindow.id as transient transport id; WindowSessionId vs buffer UUID vs TabId)
File persistence (canonical path, encoding/BOM, line endings, atomic durable save, external-change/conflict semantics owned by main file service)
Document state (separate file content/metadata from view state, cursor, undo stack; IFileState/blocks not to become a cross-process general model)
Editor engine (@muyajs/core stays DOM/browser-side and Electron-free; src/index.ts public entrypoint; OT/block tree/DOM/engine history must not cross IPC)
Testing boundary (muya package tests engine; desktop unit/E2E tests host wiring; cross-boundary behavior tested on both sides)
Future Electron shell capability grouping (window/shell/file-dialog/filesystem-document/clipboard) with legacy mt::fs::* kept only as a compatibility surface
